research_findings: Investigated the codebase and identified an offline sessions feature request mentioned in the SESSION_PERSISTENCE.md history from previous tasks.
Identified React hooks errors related to accessing `useRef` directly during component render in `AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx`, which crashes or freezes UI components.
features_improved: Fixed `AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx` by replacing the `preferReducedMotion` `useRef` with a `useState` hook and properly updating state from within `useEffect`. Added `preferReducedMotion` to the dependency array to ensure the UI updates correctly.
new_features_added: Added an Offline Sessions Dashboard page under `/profile/sessions` using Next.js app router and Shadcn UI.

Added `SessionsDashboard` component that loads sessions directly from `localStorage`, displays metadata (problem title, step count, last updated), and allows users to clear old sessions or resume practice.
next_steps_for_next_run: Add End-to-End tests for the new offline sessions dashboard.
Implement cloud syncing for offline sessions if the user signs in on a different device.
